control_test_output.summary: A sample-based review of journal voucher, vendor invoice, insurance, freight, demurrage, accrual, and non-routine transaction evidence was performed. Each sample was traced to the underlying SAP posting and validated against the testing population for posting date, amount in local currency, local currency, and transaction description. Supporting source documentation such as vendor invoices, insurance invoices, freight invoices, payment approvals, payment confirmations, accounting entries, reclassification postings, and corroborating operational evidence was inspected where available. Based on the evidence provided, 25 of the 27 requested samples were successfully validated with no exceptions noted. Two NR samples could not be validated as supporting evidence was not located within the provided testing package.
